data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to implement a Material Design Speed Dial with labels, animated icons, and children.
data.what_it_does: Renders a Material Design Speed Dial that can be placed in a Scaffold's floatingActionButton argument. It handles opening and closing animations, multi-directional children, custom labels, background overlays, and spacing automatically.
use_when: You need a floating action button that expands into multiple secondary action buttons.
You want built-in animations for expanding and collapsing a speed dial menu with labels.
avoid_when: You need a standard single action FloatingActionButton without multiple child options.
You are implementing complex bottom navigation bars or custom drawer layouts instead of floating action buttons.
strengths: Supports animated icons, custom children widgets, and dynamic labels.
Handles custom spacing, transitions, and automatic closing on back button press.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to floating action button speed dial implementations.
May require manual state configuration if custom external control of the dial state is needed.
data.setup_notes: No native configuration or permissions required; just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
